entities.name: Arzuna
entities.description: A vampire possessing beast-morphing instincts derived from Aariz Maddox’s blood, currently struggling with her predatory hunger and demonic blood rejection.
entities.quote: Arzuna stepped into the slaughter like she belonged there. Not loud. Not rushed. A vampiric silhouette in a torn coat, eyes catching the firelight like a predator catching a reflection of itself.

entities.name: Samuel Sterling
entities.description: A lethal, highly disciplined agent capable of weaponizing his necktie; he hunts experiments and tracks specific targets with extreme precision.
entities.quote: Samuel Sterling. Ghost-01. He didn’t glance back at her. Didn’t check if she was alive. Didn’t waste motion. His eyes stayed on the giant.

entities.name: Saya
entities.description: A precise operative trained by Ravenblade who assists Samuel in tracking targets.
entities.quote: Saya stepped out of the shadow like she’d always been there. Slim frame. Calm posture. Eyes sharp enough to cut distance itself.

entities.name: DEW
entities.description: The agency responsible for creating experiments using demonic blood and human flesh.
entities.quote: Stitch’s leftovers. DEW’s nightmare chemistry. Demonic blood threaded through human flesh like cursed wiring—muscle that shouldn’t move, bones that shouldn’t bend

entities.name: Ravenblade
entities.description: An organization that trains agents and issues specific operational orders.
entities.quote: As she passed a broken pillar, her outline blurred for a second—not teleportation, just enough misdirection to remind anyone watching that Ravenblade’s training had stuck.

timeline_events.title: The Camp Raid
timeline_events.description: Arzuna and Samuel Sterling engage in combat against DEW's artificially created demon-blood experiments at a ruined army camp.
timeline_events.quote: The army camp wasn’t a camp anymore. It was a torn-open mouth of tents and floodlights—half dead, half burning—metal poles bent like ribs.
